The Sanaa funeral airstrike took place on the afternoon of 8 October 2016 when 155 people were killed and at least 525 more wounded when two airstrikes, about three to eight minutes apart, hit the packed Al Kubra hall in ___E:Sanaa U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanaa)___ , ___E:Yemen U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yemen)___ during a funeral.
The attack was the deadliest single bombing in the then-two year long ___E:Yemeni civil war U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yemeni_Civil_War_(2015%E2%80%93present))___ .
The funeral was being held for the father of former interior minister ___E:Jalal al-Rowaishan U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jalal_al-Rowaishan)___ .
Sanaa mayor Abdel Qader Hilal was reportedly among those killed.
The Saudi-led coalition initially denied responsibility but then took responsibility and put the blame on information given by the Yemeni government.

The ___E:United Nations U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations)___ alleged that the Saudi-led coalition had violated international humanitarian law  because the bombing was a ' ___E:double tap U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Double_tap_strike)___ ' attack, or a type of airstrike where the first bombing is followed by a second one soon after, with the aim of targeting the wounded, aid workers, and medical personnel tending to them. The UN report said: "The second air strike, which occurred three to eight minutes after the first air strike, almost certainly resulted in more casualties to the already wounded and the first responders." Saudi Foreign Minister ___E:Adel al-Jubeir U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adel_al-Jubeir)___ said that his government was being careful to abide by humanitarian law; however, it stated that its strike on the funeral hall was based on "incorrect information" given to them by the Yemeni government and that it had been carried out without authorization.

___E:Human Rights Watch U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_Rights_Watch)___ identified the munitions used in the airstrike as 500-pound laser-guided bombs manufactured by the ___E:United States U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States)___ , and called on the U.S. to suspend arms sales to ___E:Saudi Arabia U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia)___ .
Thousands of Yemenis marched in the capital city on 9 October to protest the air raid and show solidarity to the victims.
